pwa.name: {name} – study app
home.meta-title: {name}: free gamified courses for university students
home.title: Learn the theories, level by level
home.lead: Short cards, questions that make you think, exams, spaced review and progress stored in the database with your account. Free and accessible; you can also join as a guest.
home.f1.d: Every lesson is a sequence of one-minute cards, each followed by a small question.
home.f2.t: Go as deep as you like.
home.f2.d: Core cards are the path; optional deep-dive cards add the finest detail.
home.f3.d: Spaced review boxes and a mistakes notebook bring back what you forget.
home.f4.d: Unit exams, mixed mock exams, timed or untimed, with an analysis by topic.
home.f5.d: Sign in and your progress, statistics and review boxes are stored in the database and follow you to every device. As a guest they stay in this browser.
home.f6.d: No sound, keyboard and screen-reader friendly, seven display themes including e-ink paper mode.

settings.intro: Your settings are saved automatically; when you are signed in they are stored in the database along with your progress.
settings.theme-hint: Paper mode is pure black and white with no animation, thick borders and nothing that depends on colour, made for e-ink screens.
settings.dyslexia-hint: Wider letter and word spacing and a highly legible font stack.
settings.motion-hint: Animations are always off in paper mode and when your device asks for reduced motion.
settings.reading-hint: Cards show one page at a time with next and previous buttons; scrolling shows the whole lesson on one page.
settings.tip: Tip of the day and mini test
settings.tip-hint: An in-app card when you open the home page. (Push notifications would need a server; this works without one.)
save.title: Your save file
save.intro: When you are signed in, progress is stored in the database. As a guest it stays in this browser; export a file to keep a backup or move to another device, then import it there.
save.import-msg: Replace the progress on this device with the file, or merge the two (keeping the newer entries)?
save.bad-file: This file is not an Anemone save file.
save.reset-msg: This removes XP, badges, progress, statistics and settings from this device. It cannot be undone (export a save file first if unsure).
save.memory-only: Your browser does not allow saving here (private mode?). Progress will be lost when you close the tab; export a save file to keep it.
offline.title: Offline use
offline.intro: Download the available lessons of this language so they open without a connection.
offline.failed: The download failed. Check your connection.
offline.unsupported: This browser does not support offline downloads.
account.lead: Accounts, public profiles and leaderboards are an optional extra. The whole course works without them.
account.soon: The optional account service is not switched on yet.
account.point1: No email address: a username and a password that never leaves your device.
account.point2: Profile fields are all optional and private by default.
account.point3: Leaderboards are opt-in and honour-based, because the course runs in your browser.
account.point4: You can delete your account and your data, and export everything, at any time.
